headline: Quiet day: Musk says SpaceX closed $40B in GPU debt
body: A quiet Sunday. Elon Musk said SpaceX closed about $40 billion of debt for GPUs arriving in early 2027 and warned that most neoclouds face a shakeout as credit dries up. It nudged Capability Velocity (+0.04) and Power Concentration (+0.03). Scores barely moved as earlier news faded. Contained stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance edged up to -9.23 from -9.26.
movers_note: Only small moves today: Conquerors -0.08, from fading earlier news (-0.10), partly offset by the SpaceX financing (+0.02); Descendants -0.08, from fading earlier news (-0.11), partly offset by the SpaceX financing (+0.03).
coming_up: SpaceX GPU deliveries expected in Q1-Q2 2027
